column1: # UI lint allowlist (tools/lint-ui/path-rules.sh): rule<TAB>path<TAB>reason, one entry per line.
# path is a file, or a directory ending in /, relative to the repository root. Every entry needs a
# reason; glass outside DesignSystem/Chrome/ is allowed only for the control layer (R1996).

column3: The template editor's colour swatches show colour values of the person's card styling (notetypes/workspace W6): card data drawn as written, not interface colours.

The flag symbol in the Flag menus (browser/workspace V8.1: each flag with its colour) is the SF Symbol flag.fill drawn by AppKit in its system palette colour as a non-template NSImage, because a menu draws template symbols in the text colour.
The JPEG encoder composites transparent picture pixels over white for editor/paste P7. This colour is written into the stored image.
Authored card appearance: mask-editor M3.2/M3.4 default mask and label fills and image-occlusion-format F7 imported sRGB fills; all raw colour construction is confined here, never chrome.
Authored label content uses mask-editor M3.4 and image-occlusion-format F6 Arial metrics scaled by the imported fs and scale; interface controls retain system text styles.
The #ffffff string is editor/config-keys K9's empty-slot serialization sentinel in collection data, never an interface colour.
The JPEG encoder composites the selected study image onto a white background before storage, as specified by editor/paste P7.
The canvas displays the image from the selected note’s media file so the person can place masks on its contents.
